# discord_voice_regions (Data Source)

Lists the Discord voice regions usable for voice and stage channels.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_voice_regions" "all" {}

output "optimal_regions" {
  value = [for r in data.discord_voice_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.optimal]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) The available voice regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `custom` (Boolean) Whether the region is custom (e.g. for events).
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether the region is deprecated.
- `id` (String) Unique region ID.
- `name` (String) Human-readable region name.
- `optimal` (Boolean) Whether this is the closest region to the current user.
